title: ATmega328P core (avr8js) running a compiled hex

implements.text: The ATmega328P instruction set, timers 0 to 2, USART, ADC, TWI and SPI from avr8js 0.21.1 on the Uno and Nano
Ports B, C and D mapped to nets: levels, pin modes and PWM duty from the timers
ADC reads of the voltage on a net
TWI and SPI transfers go to the I2C and SPI bus models and charge their time in CPU cycles

unsupported.text: Any chip other than the ATmega328P: no ESP32, RP2040 or ARM core
Pin electrical behaviour beyond a level and a drive strength: no pin capacitance, leakage or injection current
Fuse bits, bootloader and flash wear

knownFailureCases: No test runs the same sketch on this engine and on real hardware, so cycle counts are as good as avr8js and nothing more
